articles.title: UFO Sighting in a Dead Galaxy!
articles.summary: 2026 Exeter UFO Festival 2026 Exeter UFO Festival On September 3rd, 1965, 18-year-old Norman Muscarello reported to the Exeter Police his sighting of an unidentified flying object behind a barn in Kensington. As the Exeter police investigated the site, they too witnessed the object hovering where Muscarello had seen it. Headlines across the nation covered the story, and the rest became history as police and investigators nationwide sought to determine what young Muscarello observed that night. The Exeter Area Kiwanis Club annually sponsors a celebration of this event: The Exeter UFO Festival. Events, activities, and our speaker venue are centered in downtown Exeter NH.

September 1965 meldete der 18-jährige Norman Muscarello der Polizei von Exeter die Sichtung eines unbekannten Flugobjekts hinter einer Scheune in Kensington. Als die Polizei von Exeter den Ort untersuchte, sahen auch sie, wie das Objekt dort schwebte, wo Muscarello es gesehen hatte. Schlagzeilen im ganzen Land berichteten über die Geschichte, und der Rest wurde Geschichte, als Polizei und Ermittler im ganzen Land herauszufinden versuchten, was der junge Muscarello in dieser Nacht beobachtete.

articles.title: CENAP: Germany's Central Hub for UFO Sightings and Scientific Explanations
articles.summary: CENAP: Germany's Central Hub for UFO Sightings and Scientific Explanations The Central Research Network for Extraordinary Celestial Phenomena (CENAP) has become the primary contact point in Germany for individuals seeking scientific explanations of unusual sky observations. According to CENAP director Hansjurgen Kohler, the organisation has never received as many reports as it does now, with three to six new cases arriving daily, making it the busiest reporting centre in the German-speaking world. From amateur beginnings to a national clearinghouse Kohler, an amateur astronomer, said his involvement began with youthful recklessness while working at an observatory.
